Criteria.TestCondition: All functionality can be accessed and executed using only the keyboard.
Criteria.TesterComment: This test is not finished yet: 4 questions about it are still open. The page has an embedded frame we could not read that we cannot check automatically; please check it works with the keyboard. "#choice_117_1_0" (it appears when the mouse rests on "Artemis III" (button)) works with a mouse but can't be reached with the keyboard; a question about it is still open. "#choice_117_1_1" (it appears when the mouse rests on "Artemis III" (button)) works with a mouse but can't be reached with the keyboard; a question about it is still open. "#gform_submit_button_117" (it appears when the mouse rests on "Artemis III" (button)) works with a mouse but can't be reached with the keyboard; a question about it is still open. "#popmake-872473 > button" (it appears when the mouse rests on "Artemis III" (button)) works with a mouse but can't be reached with the keyboard; a question about it is still open. Only the first 40 elements were checked for menus that open when the mouse rests on them. We looked for: things a mouse can click that the keyboard never reaches, including inside frames; menus that open when the mouse rests on them; custom controls that ignore Enter and Space; and tooltips with information found nowhere else. Results are for the browser used (version 153.0.8010.12).

Criteria.TestCondition: A visible indication of focus is provided when focus is on the interface component.
DisabilityImpact: With Limited Language, Cognitive, and Learning Abilities
Criteria.TesterComment: Some elements don't show when they have keyboard focus, so keyboard users can lose track of where they are. We could not get a clear before-and-after view of "2 MIN READ Advanced Research, Spacewalk Preps End Week as..." (link) (scrolled out of view before the next step), so a person needs to check whether it shows focus: load the page and press Tab 26 times. When "Hide player controls" (button) gets focus, nothing on or around it changes that we could see, so keyboard users can't tell focus is there. To see it, load the page and press Tab 36 times. If you can see a focus indicator we missed, tell your assistant. When "Hide player controls" (button) gets focus, nothing on or around it changes that we could see, so keyboard users can't tell focus is there. To see it, load the page and press Shift+Tab 45 times. If you can see a focus indicator we missed, tell your assistant. We could not get a clear before-and-after view of "Play video" (button) (scrolled out of view before the next step), so a person needs to check whether it shows focus: load the page and press Shift+Tab 46 times. 83 other element(s) showed focus clearly.
